name: tilttek/quests-bundle
description: Quests and challenges for Symfony on tilttek/quests: quests in configuration or the database, seasonal dates by phil/almanac, progress and duels in Doctrine DBAL, the projection fed by tilttek/activity-bundle, events on accomplished quests and duels, Twig list and detail, commands, and member export and erasure

suggest.doctrine/orm: To add the quests' tables to the schema the ORM generates, and so to the migrations
suggest.phil/almanac: For quests that come back at computed dates, such as a week around Easter or the days of the winter solstice
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: To export and erase a member's quests with the rest of their account
suggest.symfony/console: For the commands that list the quests, show a member's and expire the duels
suggest.symfony/translation: To translate the templates' texts and the names of the quests
suggest.symfony/twig-bundle: For the Twig functions and the templates of the list and the detail of the quests
suggest.tilttek/activity-bundle: To keep the journal of activity the quests read, and catch the quests' projection up live or by a command
